description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing user-related operations, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting users, with admin and authentication middleware.

methods.name: requireAdmin(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that checks if the current user has 'admin' role, otherwise responds with 403 Forbidden.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Handler to list users; accessible only to admins.

methods.name: POST /users
methods.description: Handler to create a new user; accessible only to admins.

methods.name: GET /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to fetch details of a specific user; accessible to admins or the user themselves.

methods.name: PUT /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to update user details; accessible to admins or the user themselves with certain restrictions.

methods.name: DELETE /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to delete a user; accessible only to admins.
